name: Fort Canning Tunnel
facts: Fort Canning Tunnel, a 350‑metre, three‑lane passage, opened on 16 January 2007, cutting journey times from five minutes to a mere eighteen seconds for motorists on Stamford Road.
Constructed using the New Austrian Tunnelling method for 180 metres, the tunnel was Singapore’s first road tunnel to employ NATM, preserving 22 trees in Fort Canning Park.
The tunnel’s design includes built‑in electrical cables for continuous mobile coverage and ventilation jets, yet it deliberately omits fire exits because of its short 350‑metre length.
